faq.refferal2: Will I get any rewards for inviting friends?
faq.refferal_ans2:
Absolutely! We generously reward those who invite new friends to our project.

You will receive 10% over three levels (5%-3%-2%) from every purchase made by your referral.
faq.refferal_ans1: Yes, on the Friends page you can invite your friends and see full referral stats.
faq.balance3: How long does it take to deposit or withdraw?
faq.balance_ans3: Deposits and withdrawals in TON are instant. They take no more than 30 seconds.
faq.balance_ans2:
Go to the Balance page, enter your wallet address and press MAX

Minimum withdrawal is 0.1 TON
faq.balance1: How to top up my balance?
faq.balance_ans1: Simply go to the Balance page, connect your TON wallet, or use direct transfer via MEMO
faq.what_civilization_ans3: To start, top up your Balance and buy your first Planet
faq.what_civilization_ans2:
Yes, you receive rewards in TON for playing.

But note that CivilizationTon is a game where all deposits are voluntary donations.
faq.what_civilization_ans4: No, that is strictly prohibited and will result in account ban.
